custom_logic_notes: EA uses Rj_SlidingRangeRj_Digit_System custom indicator for signal generation with digit-based display system. CJifier_Digit provides additional confirmation. Tm (Time Manager) Plus component adds scheduled trade closing capability. The 'Digit' suffix indicates the indicator uses a digit/point-based display system for signal visualization. SL/TP values are adjusted by factor of 10 for 5-digit brokers (when _Digits==5 or _Point<0.001).
python_conversion_notes: Custom indicators Rj_SlidingRangeRj_Digit_System and CJifier_Digit must be ported or reimplemented in Python as they are not built-in. The .mqh include file contains core trading logic that must be translated. Digit adjustment logic for 5-digit brokers must be preserved. The time manager (Tm) component requires careful translation of scheduled close logic. Signal buffers from custom indicators need exact replication for faithful backtesting.
